'''Cartel Associate S3-JH''' was the designation of an associate of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Associate S3-JH recovered a hero's [[Armor/Legends|armor]] from the void of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was later sold by the Cartel.
